title.narrative: Technical Assistance for Budget and Financial Accountability - Paraguay

description.narrative: The goal of this project is to strengthen public financial management for the effective and efficient management of funds to meet critical government service delivery needs and to support inclusive economic growth. Project components include: 1) improving the accuracy of revenue forecasting; 2) improving the collection of non-tax revenues through an electronic payment system; 3) improving the organizational structure and staffing of the DGPT to facilitate new programs and functions; 4) implementing an investment program for short-term surplus cash; 5) implementing a purchasing card system for petty cash and government-funded travel to improve efficiency and control of expenditures; 6) implementing a short-term Treasury Bill program to fund short-term cash shortfalls; 7) developing key performance indicators to improve monitoring of DGPT programs; 8) implementing an electronic payment request and digital signature system to streamline payment processing; 9) improving cash management through new IFMIS system modules and training; and 10) implementing an accounts payable module to reduce processing time and costs of transactions.
